scenes.headline: What is on through the day
scenes.narration: Try the prototypes, and scan any demo to save it to your toolbox. Visit the main stage and watch live builds by the A I Maximalist team. Meet our technology partners, and join a hands-on session with the A I Academy.

scenes.headline: How a visit works
scenes.narration: Drop in any time between nine and four. Put on the headphones and try a prototype. Scan its code, and at the end of the day you get the links and a short write-up.

scenes.headline: The Agency template
scenes.narration: The template has forty-four screen types and two themes, light and dark. One script goes in, and a finished video comes out.

scenes.narration: Diagrams explain how an A I agent works. It plans, acts with its tools, checks the result, and a person approves before anything is final.

messages.text: Can I book my class 5 road test for next week?
Yes. The first opening near you is Tuesday at 10:30 in Red Deer. Shall I book it?
Booked. Your confirmation is RT-4821, and a reminder will reach your phone the day before.

scenes.headline: Why a template
scenes.narration: Instead of weeks of editing, a team writes a script. A change is an edit and a rebuild. And every ministry shares one look.
